goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Approved one coherent Slice 3 vertical package. Slice 2 is healthy, but real process recovery covers all four kill points only for authoring; branch/claim recovery is partial. SSE is memory-only and cursorless, reads/events are unauthenticated, and editor refresh can race, overwrite dirty controls, and clear disappeared selections. The existing events table already supplies durable commit_seq, so the full five-control matrix, replay/refetch, authentication, and reconciliation fit one bounded package without a schema migration or dependency.
evidence: Fresh baseline passed service 12/12, recovery 12/12, parity 12/12, and typecheck.
The four real SIGKILL points currently cover only motion.track.create; branch/claim recovery has migration, lost acquire, and restart examples rather than the required 20 cells.
The events table has durable commit_seq but ProjectStore exposes no replay query; SSE publishes no event ID and ignores reconnect cursors.
Head, immutable revision, document revision, and event reads are unauthenticated.
Editor callbacks are not serialized; refresh hydration rewrites drafts and missing selected canonical IDs are silently cleared.
Startup branch verification uses an inner join, so a dangling head can disappear instead of failing closed.

parallel_safety.reason: Store fault points, durable sequencing, authenticated streaming, shared-client cursor semantics, editor reconciliation, and browser proof share one transaction-to-render contract.

missing_evidence: A 20-cell real-process branch/claim fault matrix plus five lost-response exact retries.
Integrity, migration rollback, corrupt/dangling-head refusal, and restart proof.
Authenticated ordered replay/refetch, duplicate/gap handling, two-editor CLI refresh, dirty-draft and stable-ID browser proof.
Exact native preview, reduced motion, deterministic, privacy, and complete-diff evidence.
required_board_updates: Mark T001 done and copy the exact Worker package to T002.
Activate T002 as the sole Worker; keep T003 and T999 queued.

worker_package.objective: Implement and prove the complete Phase 3 Slice 3 control-recovery and refresh-hardening vertical slice. Extend real-process recovery to branch creation and claim acquire, renew, release, and human revoke at after-begin, after event/state inserts, before commit, and after commit before response; prove pre/post-only restart exposure, one durable transition, exact committed retry, no rejected-ID consumption, and recovery of committed notifications lost with the response. Add authenticated durable metadata-only SSE replay by commit_seq with race-safe initial head sync, cursor continuation, serialized reconciliation, duplicate suppression, gap-triggered immutable head refetch, digest validation, and cross-branch isolation. Preserve dirty form and creation drafts visibly across conflicting CLI revisions, mark their base stale, never auto-submit/replay/overwrite/discard them, and provide explicit keep/discard resolution. Reconcile track, keyframe, and creation selection only by canonical IDs, retaining visible unavailable anchors when targets disappear and restoring them only when the same IDs return. Prove connected and disconnected/reconnected refresh using the real CLI and two branch editors, exact compiler-native output, stable selection, reduced motion, zero browser errors, deterministic repetition, verifier-only secrets, and sanitized receipts. Preserve every Slice 0-2 invariant and exclude Slice 4 and later scope.

git diff --exit-code -- package-lock.json package.json AGENTS.md docs/architecture/phase3-persistence-boundary.md docs/incubation-plan.md fixtures packages/css-import packages/css-compiler packages/preview-runtime packages/visual-proof scripts
stop_if: Implementation needs a file outside allowed_files, a dependency, package or lockfile change, migration history change, or SQLite outside the sole adapter.
Replay requires event-payload state reconstruction, URL/browser-persisted credentials, or a second writer.
Subscribe/head race, cursor handoff, duplicate suppression, gap fallback, or overlapping refetch cannot be deterministically branch-safe.
Any faulted/rejected control mutates events, branches, claims, leases, revisions, IDs, or durable notification state.
Committed retry cannot return the exact stored response with original authenticated private context.
Integrity or migration refusal requires editing v1/v2 history or accepting writes before validation.
Dirty form or creation drafts cannot remain visible and unsubmitted with explicit keep/discard resolution after conflict.
Selection would use selectors/position, silently retarget, or permanently clear instead of visible canonical-ID unavailable state and restoration.
Proof requires a new persistent authoring kind, capability/secret leakage, or Slice 4+/merge/review/MCP/Lineage/publication behavior.
Existing determinism, native preview, reduced motion, sole writer, strict protocol, global revisions, branch CAS, privacy, or private-ignore proof must be weakened.
A focused verification command fails twice for the same unresolved product cause.
